description: Scan a customer domain to detect vendors and technologies currently present using deterministic fingerprints; returns detected technologies with supporting evidence and observation details. Results are point-in-time observations; eligible CSI observations may be persisted best-effort. An empty detection means no supported fingerprint was observed in that scan — it does not prove the domain uses no technology. Side effect: eligible CSI observations may be persisted best-effort to maintain customer-vendor evidence. **USE WHEN:** an agent needs to determine which supported vendors or technologies are currently detected on a specific customer domain. **DO NOT USE WHEN:** the agent needs confirmed customer base of a vendor (use vendor-customer-confirmed-lookup), historical adoption/removal events (use vendor-customer-adoption-change-lookup), or customer transition signals (use vendor-customer-transition-signal-lookup). Parameter semantics: domain is the customer domain to inspect, not a vendor domain.

domain.description: Bare public hostname (e.g., example.com). No protocol, path, query, or fragment. Localhost and IP literals rejected.
domain.title: Domain

name: customer_vendor_detection

technologies.description: Deterministically detected technologies ordered by canonical key ascending.

categories.description: Technology categories from registry metadata when available.

fingerprints.description: Bounded matched fingerprint evidence (ids and types only).

id.description: Fingerprint identifier that matched during detection.

type.description: Fingerprint type of the matched detection evidence.

name.description: Human-readable technology/vendor name when available from registry metadata.

technology.description: Canonical technology registry key (e.g., yotpo, judgeme, klaviyo).

technology_count.description: Number of technologies detected as PRESENT.

title: Customer Vendor Detection
